data.name: Brhadarashi
data.gender_notes: Brhadarashi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brhadarashi is derived from the Sanskrit term 'Brhadaras', which refers to the 'Lord of vastness'. In Hindu mythology, Brhadarashi is considered to be one of the aspects of Lord Vishnu and is often depicted as a giant, all-encompassing being. The name Brhadarashi carries the meaning “Lord of vastness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Brhadarashi usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of vastness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the infinite and all-encompassing nature of the universe and the divine.
data.etymology: Brhadarashi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of vastness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brhadarashi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Brhadarashi" carries a significant cultural impact in Hinduism, as it is closely associated with Lord Vishnu and his various aspects. In Hindu art and literature, Brhadarashi is often portrayed as a powerful and awe-inspiring deity, capable of protecting the universe and maintaining balance and order. Moreover, the use of "Brhadarashi" in personal names reflects a deep devotion and reverence towards Lord Vishnu and his vastness and power.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Brhadarashi" holds great significance as it is a reminder of the vastness and infinite nature of the divine. It serves to remind us of the immense power and love that God holds for His creation. Furthermore, by invoking the name "Brhadarashi", one can tap into this divine power and gain strength, protection, and guidance in their spiritual journey. The name is also a reminder to expand one's perspective beyond the mundane world and embrace the vast expanse of the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Brhadarashi: The radiant expanse of the supreme consciousness. This name signifies one who has realized the vastness and depth of the cosmic consciousness beyond the limited individual self.

historical_references.reference: The name Brhadarashi is mentioned in the ancient Indian text, the Mahabharata, in the context of describing the hermitage of the sage Brhadarashwa, which is located in the forest of Naimisharanya. The sage is also referred to as Brhadrashmi or Brhadarshi in various parts of the text.

Another reference to Brhadarashi can be found in the Puranic literature, specifically in the Agni Purana. In this text, Brhadarashi is described as an ascetic who performed severe penances to please the god Agni. His name is given as Brhadarshi or Brhadarshi Maharshi.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Brhadarashi' is derived from ancient Hindu scriptures and translates to 'great wakefulness'. In today's modern context, this term is often used in the context of spirituality, wellness, and meditation. On Instagram, you can find numerous accounts dedicated to sharing inspirational quotes, yoga poses, and spiritual teachings under the name Brhadarashi. On YouTube, there are several channels offering guided meditations, spiritual discourses, and yoga practices using the name. Lastly, in the App Store, there are various apps with the name 'Brhadarashi' that offer features like daily meditation reminders, inspirational quotes, and spiritual teachings.
